project: QORE-VLM Phase 9I candidate-set coverage and context-grounded answer-ranking diagnostic

baseline.equivalence_test: With every Phase 9I plugin disabled, the runner performs one unchanged Wiki-DPR Top-50 retrieval, one unchanged QORE K=5 selection, and one unchanged Generator.generate call per question; baseline scalar output must match the frozen baseline observer fixture.

core_invariants: Retrieval, QORE selection, Generator implementation, evaluator, labels, and retrieval depth remain outside the Phase 9I plugin boundary.
Each question performs exactly one Top-50 retrieval and one frozen QORE K=5 selection before any candidate or verifier probe.
Candidate producers receive only the question and frozen selected context; they never receive gold answers, EM/F1, evaluator output, labels, or selection diagnostics.
The grounded verifier receives only the question, frozen selected context, and runtime candidate strings; it never receives gold, evaluator output, or passage-selection scores.
Candidate text and raw verifier output remain in memory only; compact artifacts contain scalar metrics, candidate counts, mode IDs, timing, order-agreement, hashes, and provenance.
Candidate-oracle metrics use gold only after inference through the unchanged evaluator and never feed back into candidate generation or verifier choice.
The gold-copy control is a conditional offline control for selected-hit baseline EM errors; it is never a candidate, verifier input, selector signal, or production arm.
All formal outcomes are report-only. No diagnostic output may change select_passages, Generator settings, evaluator behavior, or labels.

interfaces.input_schema: question: str; selected_context: list[str]; frozen Generator callable
interfaces.output_schema: runtime candidate string plus compact scalar record {attempted, parse_status, generation_time_ms, candidate_mode}
invariants: Uses the pinned generator and deterministic decoding.
Candidate string is never written to compact exchange output.
No gold or evaluator value is available at generation time.

interfaces.input_schema: baseline/candidate scalar records, post-hoc evaluator EM/F1 values, candidate uniqueness and parse counters
interfaces.output_schema: candidate-oracle coverage, baseline comparison, candidate diversity, parse failure, and timing summaries
invariants: Oracle coverage is computed only after all candidate inference completes.
The baseline candidate remains in the set and baseline equivalence is auditable.
Candidate set statistics never feed back into verifier inference or selection.

interfaces.input_schema: question: str; selected_context: list[str]; candidate_mode IDs and runtime candidate strings
interfaces.output_schema: selected candidate mode/index, verifier score or choice, and generation time
invariants: Verifier prompt contains no gold answer, EM/F1, evaluator output, or selection score.
A fixed candidate-order permutation is used for the order audit.
Raw verifier text and candidate strings are discarded before compact serialization.

interfaces.input_schema: two verifier choices over identical candidate sets under original and fixed-permuted order
interfaces.output_schema: choice agreement, position-sensitivity, selected-candidate post-hoc EM/F1, and report-only gate
invariants: Order audit changes only candidate presentation order, never question, context, model, or candidate content.
Verifier agreement is computed without gold; selected-candidate EM/F1 is attached only after inference.

plugins.insertion_point: after unchanged QORE K=5 selection and before diagnostic candidate arms
plugins.hypothesis: The unchanged Generator.generate answer is the reference candidate and baseline metric.
plugins.input_schema: question and selected QORE K=5 passages
plugins.output_schema: baseline candidate runtime string and scalar EM/F1/time record
failure_signatures: baseline output differs from the stable Generator fixture
baseline generation receives a diagnostic-only field

plugins.insertion_point: conditional offline control after selected-hit baseline EM failure
plugins.hypothesis: A successful gold-copy control identifies questions where the generator can emit the target form and leaves candidate support/ranking as the diagnostic question.
plugins.input_schema: question and deterministic internal gold candidate; unavailable to candidate/verifier plugins
plugins.resource_estimate: at most one control generation per selected-hit baseline EM error
failure_signatures: copy control runs outside its declared condition
gold candidate reaches candidate or verifier prompt
copy control is treated as a production answer

plugins.insertion_point: eligible observation cohort after copy-control success
plugins.hypothesis: A verbatim span candidate can recover errors caused by the baseline answer-generation contract.
plugins.input_schema: question and selected QORE context only
plugins.output_schema: runtime extractive candidate and scalar parse/time record
plugins.resource_estimate: one deterministic generation per eligible question
failure_signatures: prompt contains gold or evaluator output
candidate is not derived from the selected context
raw candidate is serialized

plugins.insertion_point: eligible observation cohort after copy-control success
plugins.hypothesis: A short answer constrained to direct support in the selected context provides a complementary candidate to the extractive span.
plugins.input_schema: question and selected QORE context only
plugins.output_schema: runtime evidence-constrained candidate and scalar parse/time record
plugins.resource_estimate: one deterministic generation per eligible question
failure_signatures: candidate uses unsupported external knowledge
abstention/format parsing is ambiguous
prompt contains gold or evaluator output

plugins.insertion_point: after candidate inference and post-hoc scalar evaluation
plugins.hypothesis: The gap between candidate-oracle coverage and the frozen baseline separates missing-candidate failures from downstream choice failures.
plugins.input_schema: compact candidate mode records and post-hoc evaluator scalars
plugins.output_schema: candidate-oracle EM/F1, baseline deltas, unique-candidate counts, parse failures, and coverage gate
plugins.resource_estimate: scalar aggregation and paired question-level bootstrap; no model call
failure_signatures: oracle reads verifier output
duplicate candidates are counted as diversity
gold is used before candidate inference completes

plugins.insertion_point: after the in-memory candidate set is built, before post-hoc evaluation
plugins.hypothesis: When a correct candidate exists, a context-grounded verifier can select it without changing retrieval or QORE selection.
plugins.input_schema: question, selected context, and candidate mode/string pairs only
plugins.output_schema: selected candidate mode/index and scalar verifier timing/parse record
plugins.resource_estimate: one deterministic verifier generation per eligible question
failure_signatures: verifier sees gold, EM/F1, evaluator output, or selection scores
verifier emits an unparseable candidate ID
verifier changes the candidate set

plugins.insertion_point: immediately after the grounded verifier choice
plugins.hypothesis: A valid candidate-ranking signal should be stable when the same candidates are shown under a fixed permutation.
plugins.input_schema: same runtime candidate set with original and fixed-permuted presentation order
plugins.output_schema: order agreement, position-sensitivity, selected candidate post-hoc EM/F1, and gate scalars
plugins.resource_estimate: one additional deterministic verifier generation per eligible question
failure_signatures: candidate content changes between orders
order agreement is not reproducible
position bias is hidden from compact output

composition.merge_rule: Retrieve/select once; run the unchanged baseline; gate the observation cohort with the offline copy control; generate two additional candidates without gold; form the in-memory set; run the verifier twice under original and fixed-permuted order; attach evaluator scalars only after all inference; write compact scalar summaries and provenance only.
interaction_ablations: frozen baseline candidate versus candidate-oracle set
baseline candidate plus extractive span versus baseline candidate plus evidence-constrained candidate
candidate-oracle choice versus gold-blind verifier choice
verifier original order versus fixed-permuted order
eligible-cohort conditional arms versus all-question baseline

validation.baseline_equivalence: With candidate plugins disabled, fixed synthetic Generator fixtures produce the same baseline candidate and scalar metrics as the existing Phase 9H runner.
tests: verifier candidate-ID parsing and order audit

reproducibility.dataset_identity: nq_open validation[850:900] screen; formal validation[900:1100]; replication validation[1100:1300]; Wiki-DPR psgs_w100.nq.compressed, nprobe=64, one Top-50 retrieval and one frozen QORE K=5 selection per question
reproducibility.environment: Record resolved Python executable/version, git commit/status, config SHA-256, plugin-tree hash, pinned model ID/revision/config hash, retrieval/selection settings, candidate/verifier prompt profile IDs, ordering seed, timing, and output paths.

limitations: Candidate generation, verifier reranking, and grounded answer checking are established neighboring techniques; this plan claims only a diagnostic decomposition, with high novelty collision risk.
A correct candidate in the set is an offline oracle fact and does not prove that a deployable verifier can recover it.
The gold-copy control and post-hoc evaluator are diagnostic controls only; neither may enter inference or production selection.
Lexical EM/F1 and candidate normalization do not establish human entailment or answer equivalence beyond the frozen evaluator.
The screen is a contract and diversity check; a null screen is inconclusive unless it reveals a fatal implementation or privacy defect.
A positive formal diagnostic authorizes at most a separate replication and does not authorize a production selector or Generator change.
The observation-only implementation is validated locally; no Phase 9I experiment execution is included in this artifact.
